279396890.description:
Product Overview:
This lot contains a variety of collectible minerals, crystals, fossils, and decorative stones. Included are polished agate and geode slices, quartz and rose quartz pieces, a black tourmaline crystal, a fossilized fish in stone, an ammonite fossil, and several rough mineral specimens. Also present is a carved white stone angel figurine with a broken wing, along with a few small carved or shaped stones and minerals. The items display a range of colors, shapes, and forms, including both polished and rough natural states.

Specifications:
- Polished agate and geode slices
- Quartz and rose quartz specimens
- Black tourmaline crystal
- Fossilized fish in stone
- Ammonite fossil
- Rough mineral specimens
- Carved white stone angel figurine (broken wing)
- Assorted small carved or shaped stones and minerals
